pre_registered_null: no structural scalar predicts forward drive across control seeds

protocol.analysis: pure graph analysis; no body rollouts
protocol.input_forward_drive_definition: raw B1 8 s forward-distance mean per real/random/rewired condition
protocol.spectral_method: deterministic 64-step Arnoldi on W, abs(W), and positive-part(W)
protocol.bootstrap: 95% percentile bootstrap using frozen campaign repetitions and seed

constructors.random-network: reservoir_3way.randomize_weights fixed sparse structure; signed weight multiset preserved
constructors.rewired-network: reservoir_3way.degree_preserving_rewire; row and column degree plus weight multiset preserved

null_screen.rule: every non-degenerate pooled Pearson 95% bootstrap CI includes zero
null_screen.interpretation: one or more scalar candidates require independent validation
